title: Evaluate the bit-motif parking node at Psi one half
body:
## Summary
- The bit-motif parking schedule makes one recursive call per unit of edge rank, each of width `e/m`. The child list is `177176569088785861287000000` copies of width 1.
- The modulus is `1000000` and the role count is `177176569091445000000`. At `tau = 1/2`, Psi equals `22587334999661/22587335000`, which is greater than 1.
- No network replay and no new exponent. The manuscript's own exponent `1-2^{-50}` is not evaluated here.
